name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Questions (o-questions)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-questions markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Questions (o-questions)

Record and read questions only through mtm: the mtm MCP gateway (`run` with `question.question ...`) or, without MCP, the mtm CLI (`mtm question ...`, for example `mtm question ask WORDS` and `mtm question answer ID TEXT`). Never put secrets in a question, answer, tag or link.

When the owner asks you a question (they want to know something, not to have something done), record it with `question.question ask`, passing the owner's words exactly as typed. After you answer, record the answer with `question.question answer` (the full answer, or a faithful summary with links to anything longer). Put a follow-up in the same thread with `question.question follow-up` (or `ask` with `follow_up_of`). Record only questions from the owner's own messages, not from a brief another agent sent you.

When you need a decision from the owner, do not ask in chat when o-questions is available. Record it with `question.question pose`: the context in `question` and `details`, and 2 to 4 choices as `options`, each an id and a short label in the owner's own words (an optional description says what it does). Never write options as yes/no unless the question is literally yes/no: name the thing each option does. Name your pick in `recommended` (an option id) and give the reason in `recommendation`. When the decision is a list of independent picks (branches, files, tasks), pose `items` instead: a checklist where the owner checks what to do (checked means do it, unchecked means do not); mark the ones you recommend with `recommended`. Later, moot, ask-back and a free-text answer are always offered; do not make them options. Give a stable `key`; posing again keeps the owner's choice while its option or item id exists. The owner answers on the Decisions page. Read decisions with `question.decision export` (CLI: `mtm question decision export`; it gives the chosen option's id and label, or the outcome, and each item's checked state), answer the owner's asks with `question.question reply`, and after acting on a decision record it with `question.question applied` (for a checklist, once per item with `item`).
